answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the comet is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Every checkpoint root is anchored to a public chain and the full history replays for anyone. That makes each attestation permanently attributable: a copper that vouched for junk is a timestamped record the audit lanes can act on later. So a shale of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal bydr3.
